title: GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times Revealed: Xbox New Zealand Trick
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 worldwide unlock times have been revealed. The game arrives November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, with Xbox owners potentially using the New Zealand trick.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Grand Theft Auto 6 Worldwide Unlock Times Revealed: Xbox New Zealand Trick

The countdown to the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 is officially moving forward. According to recent reports, Rockstar Games' monumental open-world title is scheduled to arrive on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. As the release date approaches, details regarding when players around the globe can actually jump into the action have begun to emerge.

### Global Release and Unlock Schedules

November 19 marks a monumental date on the gaming calendar, but when players actually get to play varies depending on where they are located in the world. Due to international time zones, the exact moment the digital gates open will differ from region to region. This staggered approach is standard practice for major global launches, designed to manage server loads and give players a structured rollout.

### The Return of the Xbox New Zealand Trick?

An interesting detail highlighted in recent reports is that Xbox owners can seemingly still use the classic "New Zealand trick" to play the game early. Because New Zealand sits far ahead in the global time zones, players on Microsoft's consoles have historically been able to change their console or account region to New Zealand to unlock digital games earlier than their local time zone would normally permit.

While players will need to verify if this classic workaround remains fully functional for GTA6 closer to the launch date, the prospect has already sparked excitement among the Xbox Series X/S community eager to shave hours off the wait time.

## Editor's Take

The release of GTA6 on November 19 is shaping up to be a historic moment for the industry. The discussion around regional unlock times and the enduring Xbox New Zealand trick highlights just how eager fans are to dive into the experience. Whether you wait for your local midnight or try your luck with time zone adjustments, the launch is almost here.
